description: SYNTHORA pago-seguro: Can I pay this account? Anti-fraud check for supplier bank-detail changes (BEC / invoice fraud) in ONE call: IBAN validity (ISO 13616, country, bank code, SEPA), change versus the previous IBAN (bank or country switch), EU VAT in VIES, LEI in GLEIF, official sanctions lists (OFAC SDN, UN consolidated, UK Sanctions List, EU consolidated financial sanctions list; if a list has no fresh download, a no-match screening is not charged unless you send acepta_parcial=true) and the email that asked for the change (headers: lookalike sender domain, Reply-To mismatch, SPF/DKIM/DMARC [x402: 0.0095 USDC per call on Base]

cabeceras_correo.description: Raw headers of the email that requested the change

receptor_correo.description: authserv-id of YOUR receiving mail server (e.g. mx.google.com); only that Authentication-Results line is trusted
